levels.description: Static architecture, policy, schema, manifest, and source-contract checks. A pass proves only that reviewed source satisfies declared invariants.
Deterministic behavior of one function, class, or isolated module without external process, platform, or network claims.
Behavior across a bounded component boundary with real serialization, persistence, IPC, or adapter contracts where applicable.
End-to-end behavior across multiple production components with durable state, cleanup, and failure visibility.
Real behavior on a named mandatory platform. Source inspection, emulation, or another operating system cannot substitute.
Fault injection, hostile inputs, abuse cases, race conditions, and security-negative behavior with explicit recovery or unknown state.
Versioned reproducible performance, quality, throughput, resource, or agent-evaluation measurement with declared environment identity.
Certification of an exact release candidate after all applicable lower assurance evidence, independent review, and support-policy gates.
